sentences.text:
The accused has been charge sheeted for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 323,
506 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. The summary of the charge sheet is that, the defacto complainant is legally wedded wife of the accused No.1.
On 25.5.2020 at about 4.00 p.m. started assaulting the defacto complainant stating that, as to why she admitted the child to the hospital, and abused her in filthy language.

At the time of marriage, Rs.5 lakh and 5 tholas of gold were given in the form of dowry, and the accused No.1 demanded to bring additional money of Rs.5 lakh and 10 thola of gold from the parental home.
The learned Magistrate after accepting the charge sheet took the cognizance of the aforesaid offence and issued summons.
Taking exception of the same, the petitioner - accused No.1 is before this Court.

3. The learned counsel for the petitioner - accused No.1 submits that, the FIR was lodged by the 2nd respondent as a counter blast to circumvent the FIR registered against the defacto complainant and her family members for the offence punishable under Section 307 of IPC and among other offences.
He further submits that, except the interested statement of CW1 and CWs.5, 6 and 7, who are the accused in the FIR lodged by the accused No.1, the independent witnesses have not been recorded.
Hence, he submits that, the FIR was lodged with an ulterior motive to circumvent the FIR registered against the defacto complainant and her family members.
4. Though the 2nd respondent is served with notice, he has not chosen to appear in person or through her counsel.

5. The learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent No.1 - State submits that, the FIR discloses the commission of cognizable offence, and veracity of the allegation against the accused herein cannot be considered in this petition, and the same can be considered after full-fledged trial.
Hence, he submits that the cognizance taken by the learned Magistrate does not warrant any interference.

sentences.text: 6. Considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties.
7. The alleged incident has taken place on 25.5.2020 at about 4.00 p.m.
On the same incident, the accused No.1 had lodged the FIR against CWs.5, 6 and 7 on the very same day at 6.00 p.m.

Thereafter, the FIR was lodged by the defacto complainant on the same day at 8.30 p.m, which clearly implies that, the FIR was lodged as a counter blast so as to circumvent the FIR registered against CWs.5, 6 and 7, who are the parents and brother of the defacto complainant.

The alleged incident has taken place in the hospital, and none of the statement of independent witnesses to the incident has been recorded, except the statement of CWs.5, 6 and 7, who are the alleged eye witnesses to the incident.

The police have not produced any material that, the defacto complainant sustained injuries due to the assault by the accused to constitute the offence punishable under Section 323 of IPC.
8.

To constitute the offence punishable under Sections 504 and 506 of IPC, the intentional insult must be of such a degree so as to cause breach of public peace or commission of any other offences by the defacto complainant or by any other person.
In the instant case, the alleged abusive language used has not resulted in causing breach of public peace or commission of any other offence by the defacto complainant.

9. In view of the preceding analysis, I am of the view that, the FIR was lodged by the 2nd respondent as a counter blast to circumvent the FIR registered against the defacto complainant, and her family members in Crime No.123/2020 for the offence punishable under Section 307 and among other penal offences.
Hence, the continuation of criminal proceedings against the petitioners - accused herein will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) Criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The impugned proceeding in CC No.702/2020 pending on the file of the Civil Judge and JMFC Court, Lingasugur, Raichur, insofar as it relates to accused No.1 is hereby quashed.
